notes: Product review batch 1 (v1.11.30): five P1 ideas (P1-1–P1-5). P1-1: tick dates — state.done is now { d: "YYYY-MM-DD" } (the study day the box was ticked); old ticks stay `true` (done, date unknown — never fabricated, never dropped); un-tick still writes false; the two-way Google done sync reads truthiness, so it works unchanged. P1-2: Dey-month builder — a wizard in the Exams tab builds a proposal for the Dey programme from the Maz 7+8 budgets (reviews 2h + tests 1.5h per budget chapter, max 2 boxes of one subject per day, tests after their reviews, exam days empty, 30 min general subjects every day); nothing is created until Apply, which adds ordinary custom boxes and extends the programme range; the 13 Dey school exams are not in exams.json yet, so the wizard says so instead of inventing them. P1-3: single connection-health card on the dashboard (ICS pull + OAuth push + last push + conflicts, from the same /api/calendar/status payload) and the topbar sync button now pulls AND pushes and reports both honestly. P1-4: two-number hero — the main bar is time progress (real ÷ planned), the second bar is tick progress (ticked ÷ planned, with the box count). P1-5: "now and next" sticky bar — the current box with minutes left + a timer button, and the next box (tomorrow's first when today is over); isCurrentBox stays a no-op list filter by design. Known totals unchanged: حسابان 3489, شیمی 3000; گسسته and فیزیک have none (2110 not reintroduced). The 1.11.18 examDateText live-computation fix, the 1.11.27 delete-retry fix and the 1.11.28–1.11.29 batch fixes are untouched.
